record.title: Polish farmers obstruct Ukrainian frontier approaches in Lubelskie in spring2024
record.scope: Intermittent/selective road blockades in Lubelskie; not all Poland–Ukraine frontier
record.crossings: Dorohusk–Yahodyn; Hrebenne–Rava-Ruska; later Zosin–Ustyluh and Dołhobyczów–Uhryniv
record.direction: Freight movement through affected posts; direction-specific phases not fully reconstructed
record.movement: Road freight; selective/hourly passage at some phases
record.exceptions: Humanitarian and military consignments excepted in initial Dorohusk report
record.enforcement: Protesters controlled frontier approach-road access and substantially limited commercial passage.
record.relationship: Separate farmers’ protest regime after January trucker suspension. Medyka/Korczowa episodes remain outside this Lubelskie record.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status extrapolation to 21 October 2026
record.official_rationale: Protesters opposed Ukrainian agricultural imports and EU Green Deal policies.
record.context: Protesters opposed Ukrainian agricultural imports and EU Green Deal policies.
record.uncertainty: Start covers first two posts only. Zosin ended21March, Dołhobyczów16April, Dorohusk22April. Hrebenne protesters left28April evening; normal traffic confirmed29April. No continuous multi-post duration.
